name: Rawson
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A wine area in San Juan, one of Argentina's most important wine provinces. Cereza dominates plantings at 52%, followed by Pedro Giménez (10%) and Syrah (7%).
